rollout.tool: actual scene_classify, registered tool calls only, role-separated feedback
rollout.state: same last valid decoding-step final-layer final-position hidden tensor is cached and passed to frozen scorer; no terminal forward-state replacement
rollout.quality: nonempty completed answer, no generated result tags, no mixed/unknown tool calls, no addCriterion, no token-limit or round-limit; failures retained
rollout.format_reward: 0.2 exactly when new rollout quality passes, otherwise 0.0; stricter than historical regex-only bonus
rollout.sampling_distribution: untruncated categorical softmax; first-token EOS suppression from min_new_tokens=1 is identically applied in policy logprob
rollout.tool_boundary_stop: stop immediately once a registered scene_classify call has been generated, closing tag optional; execute actual tool before sampling any result text

training.loss: original standardized-group-advantage times sum of effective assistant log probabilities; per-round backward and group mean
training.advantage_std: sample standard deviation; skip optimizer for groups with std<=1e-8
training.seeds: 110000 + step_index*4 + sample_index; same schedule for each arm
training.train_prompt_source: original train Arrow, first caption surviving canonical val-text purge

stage: train-only purged reward gallery and conditional same-scene hard-negative pilot
training_prompt: first original training caption retained after canonical validation-text purge

pilot.same_scene_arm_gate: at least ceil(0.25 * training_image_count) image groups have max absolute global-vs-same-scene standardized total-reward advantage difference > 0.05

evaluation.policy_points: baseline, format_only, global_margin; scene_margin added only by prespecified training-only pilot gate
evaluation.primary: fresh50 greedy image-mean final AGSE RR
evaluation.expand_criterion_global: global-margin greedy RR paired 95% lower bounds > 0 vs format and initial; greedy quality within 5pp of initial; actual optimizer updates > 0
evaluation.expand_criterion_scene: scene-margin greedy RR paired 95% lower bounds > 0 vs global-margin and format; mean RR >= initial; greedy quality within 5pp of initial; actual optimizer updates > 0
evaluation.checkpoint_selection: last attempted group; no validation choice among epochs; training-only pilot fixes experiment branch before new validation generation
